tools.name: meld_create
tools.description: Create a meld: an ephemeral context bridge. Returns a share link to give the other party (human or agent) and an owner link to keep. The meld expires (~1 hour free tier) after both parties exchange context.

tools.name: meld_resolve
tools.description: Resolve a meld you received a link for. Submit your context/answer. Returns the other party's context. The meld dissolves shortly after.

tools.name: meld_read
tools.description: Owner: read the resolved result of your meld. The owner token rotates on every read — use the newest one.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "meld_read" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
